title: Rudul Sah v State of Bihar

content.caseIdentity: Rudul Sah v State of Bihar, (1983) 4 SCC 141
content.facts: Complete restraint is essential to the common-law tort; constitutional compensation for unlawful detention is analytically distinct.
questionsBeforeCourt: What legal rule governs the doctrine?
content.ratioDecidendi: Complete restraint is essential to the common-law tort; constitutional compensation for unlawful detention is analytically distinct.
content.holding: Complete restraint is essential to the common-law tort; constitutional compensation for unlawful detention is analytically distinct.
content.relevance: Use the authority for the precise proposition it decides.
